sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Augmented Attack is a Pictos in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33. Effect: 50% increased Base Attack damage.

sections.title: How to Get Augmented Attack
sections.content: Location: Spring Meadows - defeat the Chromatic Lancelier.

sections.title: Is It Worth Equipping?
sections.content: Pictos unlock a Lumina after four battles, so equipping it once is enough to keep the effect permanently available for the Lumina cost.
